def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # Maps key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, (_, wt) in cache.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it to re-add at end (most recently used)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            
            # If cache is at capacity and we're adding a new key, evict LRU
            if len(cache) >= capacity and key not in cache:
                # Remove the first (least recently used) item
                cache.popitem(last=False)
            
            # Add/update the entry
            cache[key] = (value, t)
            # Move to end to mark as most recently used
            cache.move_to_end(key)
            
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, (_, wt) in cache.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # Get the value
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                results.append(value)
                # Mark as most recently used
                cache.move_to_end(key)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
